1.0.0.8.fixed: Should no longer crash on older versions of C3

1.0.0.9.fixed: Fixed a bug that could cause naming conflicts on the domside

1.0.0.10.fixed:
Fixed a crash on recent Construct releases ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '_audioFiles')")
"On audio unloaded" now triggers properly
Loading a file that is in several groups now checks every group, so all the groups it completes trigger "On group loaded"
Adding an already loaded file to a group, or removing a file from one, now updates the group: "On group loaded" triggers when every file left is loaded
